desc: Derive and verify the greedy proof: if the minimum boundary strength is not absorbable, no boundary slime is; absorbing any eligible boundary slime only increases strength and exposes cells.
Specify the graph-expansion invariant: each cell is marked seen when inserted into the frontier, so it enters the heap at most once.
Implement heap-based expansion over four directions from `(P-1, Q-1)`, maintaining a min-heap of exposed cells.
Implement the strict condition exactly as `candidate_strength * X < current_strength` using Python integers.
Run all provided samples and verify outputs; confirm complexity is `O(HW log(HW))` and handle edge cases.
